summary_en: Raman called to inquire about ordering 200 matte visiting cards and requested pricing and delivery details. The agent quoted ₹700, with delivery in Vijayawada within 3 working days after artwork approval; urgent 24-hour delivery would cost an additional ₹150. Raman clarified that he only wanted visiting cards and was asking about wedding cards for information, not to place a wedding-card order. The agent explained that wedding-card pricing depends on design, paper sample, and quantity, so no fixed phone quote was available. Raman then confirmed that his name, product, and quantity had been noted; the agent stated that Raman, 200 matte visiting cards, and the quantity were recorded, and asked for the delivery area for a quote. Raman ended the call politely without providing the delivery area or confirming an order.
next_action: Obtain Raman's delivery area if he proceeds with the visiting-card quote/order.
